Theorem
[Bochner vanishing for nonpositive Ricci curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0333 ↗ prop:pet-ch8-killing-norm-formulas 1. ch8:8.2.2Suppose $(M,g)$ is compact with $\mathrm{Ric}\le 0$. Then every Killing field is parallel. Furthermore, if $\mathrm{Ric}<0$, then there are no nontrivial Killing fields.
Proof

↗ thm:pet-ch8-bochner-negative-ricci \sketch For a Killing field $X$, section 2 gives

\[ \Delta \! \left( frac 12|X|^2 ight) =| abla X|^2-\operatorname {Ric}(X,X)\ge 0. \]

Compactness and the maximum principle force this function and its Laplacian to be constant, hence $ abla X=0$. If $\operatorname {Ric}<0$, the same equality also forces $X=0$.

□
